headline: India's GDP surprises again! 7.8% growth in the first quarter, PM Modi praises it
summary: India's GDP grew 7.8% in the first quarter of fiscal 2026-27, above the 7.3% estimate and the RBI's 7% forecast. Domestic consumption, government capex, manufacturing and services supported growth.
why: GDP growth is the main gauge of India's economic health and shapes expectations for interest rates, corporate earnings and rupee assets.
